findings.claim: Passengers in higher classes (Pclass) may have a higher survival rate (Survived).
findings.evidence: Mean survival rates are 0.6296 for 1st class, 0.4728 for 2nd class, and 0.2424 for 3rd class.

findings.claim: Females had a higher survival rate than males.
findings.evidence: Mean survival rate for females is 0.742 while for males it is 0.1889.

findings.claim: Passengers who paid higher fares had a higher survival rate.
